breaker_loss.locator: Eaton 102244 FAZ-C6/3-NA datasheet, p.2, design verification
breaker_loss.note: 3.5 W whole device at 6 A, not per pole. Manufacturer document mirrored by distributor.

control_breaker.note: 2.8 W whole device at 2 A; UL489 10 kA at 480Y/277 V. Manufacturer datasheet mirror.

contactor.locator: LC1D09BD, power dissipation per pole / hold-in consumption
contactor.note: 0.2 W/pole AC-3 plus 5.4 W DC coil. Three power poles = 6.0 W total; no AC-coil FAQ used.

overload.note: 1.67 VA at maximum setting, taken as 1.67 W resistive thermal loss for complete device.

supply.locator: p.1 HDR-60-24; p.3 derating; p.4 dimensions
supply.note: 24 V 2.5 A 60 W, typical 90% efficiency at full load, 52.5 x 90 x 54.5 mm. Loss estimate 60*(1/.90-1), not a guaranteed maximum at all loads.

plc.note: 120 mA at 24 V logic supply; all 2.88 W assumed to heat panel.

plc_wiring.note: 8 DC inputs and 6 relay outputs. CPU 24 V x 0.120 A = 2.88 W; seven wired inputs bounded by (2 x 0.006 + 5 x 0.005) A x 26.4 V = 0.9768 W. Sum 3.8568 W included in heat and DC budget. Maximum channel currents are specified at 26.4 V.

cooling.locator: Calculation basis for enclosure climate control, p.13
cooling.note: Qsurface=k*A*(Ti-Ta), natural rise=Q/(k*A); steel k=5.5 W/m2K.

air.note: Sea-level air-flow factor 3.1 m3 K/(Wh). Residual heat method after enclosure surface cooling.

fan.note: 24 V DC; rated 2.4 W; 16 m3/h WITH two 3237200 outlets (15 with one), 20 free-air; 92 x 92 mm cutout. p.4 legacy tender text says 3 W, used conservatively in heat and DC budget.

scenario.note: Simulated machine nameplate, environment, wiring allowances, generic field loads and layout envelopes. These are design choices, not measured/manufacturer claims.

sheets.title: Incoming power and motor starter
notes: 208 V, 3 phase, 60 Hz, grounded-wye only. Assumed available fault: 4 kA rms symmetrical.
Q0: incoming breaker. Q1: motor short-circuit protection. No selective trip coordination claimed.
OL1: 1.6-2.5 A range; simulated M1 nameplate 2.0 A; manual reset. Motor loss is outside enclosure.
Power: 14 AWG Cu design choice. PE: green/yellow, never switched or fused. No neutral required.
Concept study only. Upstream lockout/isolation, guarding and safety-rated stop need engineered review.

sheets.title: 24 V DC distribution and bonding
notes: PS1 is fed line-to-line at 208 V (01). 24 V / 2.5 A supply; all field loads included in DC budget.
F4: 1 A PLC; F3: 2 A control/field; F5: 2 A fan. Control conductors: 18 AWG Cu design choice.
0 V has one intentional bond to PE at the DC distribution terminal; protective earth stays continuous.
PLC V+ and GND power logic only. Relay output commons are separately wired on 04.
B1 is continuously supplied. EF1/EF2 outlets give 16 m3/h installed, not 20 free-air.

sheets.title: PLC inputs and field terminal strip
notes: A1: C0-00DR-D. X1 bottle present; X2 start; X3 stop healthy; X4 enable healthy;
X5 overload tripped; X6 contactor feedback; X7 reset; X8 spare (unconnected). C1/C2 to 0 V.
S0 and S3 use separate NC monitoring poles here. Their hardwired interrupt poles are on 04.
S4 brown=24CTL, blue=0V, black=PNP signal. X2 terminal strip: numbered internal and field sides.
Stop and enable are educational interlocks only, not an emergency-stop or safety function.

sheets.title: Hardwired inhibit and PLC relay outputs
notes: 24CTL -> S0 NC -> S3 NC -> OL1 95-96 NC -> A1 C3. Opening any contact removes Y1-Y4 load supply.
A1 relay group C3 supplies Y1-Y4; C4 (Y5/Y6) unused. Y4/Y5/Y6 are spare and unconnected.
Y1 energizes K1 coil (A1/A2), Y2 opens YV1, Y3 lights H1. All loads return to 0 V.
K1 BD has built-in suppression. YV1 diode cathode at +24. X2:11/12 sensor power; X2:13 valve return.
Start latches a cycle; bottle stops conveyor and starts a 2 s fill. Stop/enable/overload aborts; reset then start.
No automatic restart. See python3 -m panel simulate for executable timing and fault sequence.

sheets.title: Panel layout, dimensions in mm
notes: E1: 600 H x 400 W x 200 D steel. Coordinates below are millimetres from backplate upper-left.
Main power left; 24 V control right. Separate duct routes. DIN rails at y=100, 290, 460 mm.
Envelopes include conservative planning sizes; verify final vendor drawings and wiring clearances before build.
PS1: reserve 40 mm above, 20 below per mounting guidance. Keep fan intake and upper outlet clear.
Door: S0, S1, S2, S3 and H1, 30 mm envelopes. Bond door to PE. No mains devices on door.
REV B: added B1 fan, EF1/EF2 outlets and F5 fuse after 40 C ambient check. Redline: drawings/revisions/.
